newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's IRSA downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's IRSA downgraded.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming announced it was downgrading Argentine real estate company IRSA, whose main shareholder is investor George Soros, to Hold from Buy.

-- "At current levels, we have estimated that IRSA is trading at a premium of between 10.5 percent and 22 percent over its NAV (Net Asset Value) of $30.78 and $33.67 per GDS (Global Depositary Share) calculated using conservative and optimistic assumptions, respectively," analysts Jose Costa Buck and Gonzalo Pangaro wrote in a report.

-- "With the stock having risen by 36 percent since we upgraded our recommendation (surpassing our target price of $34 per GDS) to a Buy on September 13, 1996, we are downgrading our recommendation to hold," they added.
